newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - Barings ups Cementos Norte to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Barings ups Cementos Norte to buy.

text.p: ING Barings said its analysts had upgraded Cementos Norte Pacasmayo to buy from hold on the basis of potential upside in price.
"ING Barings sets CNP's new 12-month target price at $1.80 per share, giving its common and labor shares a potential upside of 17 percent," said a statement from ING Baring.

It added that Peru's second largest cement producer was "enjoying the current rebound in the cement market triggered by publicly sponsored housing projects, a strong retail sector and government infrastructure projects."
ING Barings had downgraded CNP from buy to hold April 22 due to price appreciation.
